title: 8 Things a Godly Man Is Harder on Than He Is on You
caption:
Most guys flip it. Soft on their own sin, sharp with everyone else's.

A godly man runs the mercy the other direction. He's harder on his own excuse than yours. Harder on the sin nobody saw than the mistake everybody did. Harder on his follow-through than his intentions. His private hour gets more scrutiny than your public one ever will.

That's not self-hatred. It's just where the log actually is.

"Why do you see the speck in your brother's eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye?... first take the log out of your own eye." (Matthew 7:3-5)

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
